unknowns: U-ben5-1: WHY the echelon coefficients are rational to all tested orders. The derivation in part_series_recognition guarantees it only for n <= i+16; beyond that it is an observation. A clean statement would be that the disc coordinate v is, up to scaling, a Q-rational coordinate -- equivalently that phi^{1/9} generates the same Q-power-series ring as v. Not proved here.

U-ben5-2: whether the residual rational torus X_i -> r^{i-1} X_i admits a normalisation with smaller coefficients than the one certified. No search was made; the model is primitive-integral but not proved minimal.

U-ben5-3: the arithmetic meaning of the twist nu^2 = -3/2. The quadratic form Q|_W of the standard representation has Gram diag(2,-1) in the series normalisation, whose SO is the norm-one torus of Q(sqrt 2) and therefore has no rational 3-torsion; that is the whole obstruction. Whether the class -3/2 (equivalently -6) has an independent modular interpretation is not investigated.
U-ben5-4: ben5 identifies (X, phi) with the ben1-frozen target only through the ben1-ben4 chain. No independent arithmetic confirmation (e.g. CONN-1) was run.
